whatItDoes: Would authorize New Mexico to borrow up to $21,582,213 through general obligation bonds for senior citizen facility improvements, construction and equipment. A general property tax would pay the bonds’ principal, interest and issuance-related expenses.
yesMeans: A FOR vote would authorize these senior-facility bonds and the property tax to repay them.
noMeans: An AGAINST vote would reject authorization for these bonds and their repayment tax through this question.
